name: 2-minute rule
tip: If it feels huge, commit to working on it for just 2 minutes. You can stop right after.

name: Just open the file
tip: Don't write anything yet—literally just open the document or notebook and title the page.

name: Write a bad first draft
tip: Give yourself permission to write complete garbage. A messy draft can be polished; a blank page cannot.

name: 5-minute timer
tip: Set a timer for 5 minutes and focus on one tiny detail. When the timer rings, you can take a break.

name: Body doubling
tip: I am right here with you purring by your screen. You do your step, and I'll keep watch.

name: Drink water & reset
tip: Take a slow sip of cool water, roll your shoulders back, and unclench your jaw.

name: Change location
tip: Shift to another chair, stand up for a stretch, or move your laptop to a brighter spot.

name: Write just one sentence
tip: Write just one simple sentence or note down 3 messy bullet points without worrying about formatting.

name: Solve example or problem #1
tip: Ignore the entire problem set. Look only at question #1 or copy down the first given formula.

name: Messy brain dump
tip: Scribble whatever messy thoughts you have on a piece of scrap paper or sticky note to unload your mind.

name: Read just one heading or paragraph
tip: Don't read the whole chapter. Just read the next bold heading and the very first sentence underneath it.

name: 10-second breath break
tip: Inhale gently for 4 counts, hold for 4, and sigh it out. Your nervous system comes first.

name: Clear 3 items from desk
tip: Clear just three cups, pens, or wrappers off your desk so your hands have clean breathing room.

name: Slice in half twice
tip: Cut what you think you need to do in half. Then cut that half in half again. That's your true first step.
